text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm a real festival lover, and I'm here
to, uh...
Um...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, relax! Your smile's way too stiff! ☆
There's
nothing more important to an
Umadol than her
charming smile! ☆ Got
it? ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The path to becoming an Umadol is by
no means
an easy one. But the reason
we're even in this
situation is because of
what happened a few
hours ago...
choice_data_list: リラックスしていこう！

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So even though you've already set the
date for
your concert, you don't have
enough people to
perform in it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Suzuka, Ines, and everyone else
said they
already have other plans that
day!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But then you came along, Kita! ♪ You
appeared
before me like a sparkly flash
of light! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So what do you think? Wanna try being
an
Umadol?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
E-erm, well, I don't really know anything
about
being an Umadol...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But I'm more than happy to help you
out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... This is a lot more involved than I
thought
it would be when I offered to
help earlier without
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's hard trying to introduce yourself in a
cute
way! It's just so embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but you've got heaps of potential,
Kita! ☆
choice_data_list: ウマドルってなかなか大変だな
ウマドルってなかなか大変だね
choice_data_list_en: Being an Umadol is pretty tough work.
Being an Umadol is pretty tough work, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're cheerful, active, handsome, and
cute. ☆
Plus, our personalities
complement each other,
which is
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't feel discouraged, and let's keep

practicing! ♪ Once we've nailed down
your intro,
we can move on to how to
interact with the crowd
and practice
your autograph! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eep! I-I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kitasan Black trains hard every
day to
become an Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, everyone! ♪ It's me,
Smart
Falcon! I hope I make your hearts
race today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Falcooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the cheers are deafening! All
right, it's my
turn...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm Kitasan Black! A real lover of
festivals, and I'm
here to set off
fireworks in your heart!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Kita, you're sooo cute! Please
look this
way!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What are you doing here, Dia?!
And
Trainer too?!
choice_data_list: いいぞー、輝いてるぞっ！
いいよー、輝いてるよっ！
choice_data_list_en: Looking good! You're really shining out there!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for cheering for me, but you
don't have to
force yourself to call me
cute or anythi—

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: How cuuute!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Why's everyone saying that?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because they think it's adorable how
flustered
you get from being
complimented! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
O-oh man, how should I respond to
them?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
O-oh man, how should I respond to
them?
choice_data_list: 思い出すんだ、ウマドルは――
思い出して？ウマドルは――
こっちファンサービスくださーい！
choice_data_list_en: Some fan service over here, please!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! My charming smile! ☆ Teehee!
choice_data_list: 思い出すんだ、ウマドルは――
思い出して？ウマドルは――
こっちファンサービスくださーい！
choice_data_list_en: Some fan service over here, please!

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe, see? Isn't she adorable?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've known how cute you were
since long
ago, Kita! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Dia, everyone—thank you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I knew I was right ☆ You've got real
Umadol
potential, Kita! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the concert's huge success,
Smart
Falcon keeps enthusiastically
soliciting Kitasan
Black to become an
Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay!

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text:
We want some too! Look this way,
pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um, how's this?

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Male Umadol Fan
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black... She's so cute... I'm a fan
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Keep it up, Kita! Your special training is
paying
off! ☆ All right, let's get started
with our first
song! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Listen closely, everyone! Today,
we'll be
singing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to how moved everyone
was by
Kitasan Black's hard work
onstage, a huge line
forms for the
handshake event after the concert.
